intent: system stepped animation clock — immediate interactions, stepped periodic timing
useWhen: all periodic animations (atmosphere, weather fields, grown lifecycle states); interactions get no recipe at all — they are immediate hard cuts with no transition and no easing
avoid: smooth easing affordances on any animation (ease, ease-in-out, linear, cubic-bezier) and every interaction transition
notes: periodic motion is evaluated at 8fps using stepped keyframe timing; the motion tokens carry periodic loop lengths only — no transition duration and no easing curve
speed and delay randomized deterministically using LCG

intent: short one-shot stepped growth from zero to the intrinsic block size of a newly present surface
useWhen: a menu, popover, sheet, or fold body has just become present and its paper boundary should grow into place around fixed content
avoid: per-member delay, opacity animation, or transform; a state change on an element already on the page (hover, press, selection, focus stay immediate hard cuts); any transition declaration; any smooth easing curve (ease, ease-in-out, linear, cubic-bezier)
notes: reveal is periodic-clock motion that runs once rather than an interaction affordance — the boundary is whether the element was rendered a frame ago. the invoking press is instant; the surface then grows from zero to intrinsic block size over two 8fps frames (250ms). content stays fixed with no independent animation. timing remains in the style module, so the value layer keeps holding periodic loop lengths only. the reduced-motion pose holds the container at intrinsic block size.
